_readme: Calibration set for the Phase 2 vision classifier (build spec: 15-25 past jobs).
Copy to manifest.json, download the job photos from the KTU Drive folder
(Vendors & Products > Tune up) into calibration/photos/<job>/, and fill in the
level ACTUALLY CHARGED for each job (L1_2, L3, or L4 — SM merges levels 1 and 2).
Use BEFORE photos only. Then run: npm run calibrate
SOURCES: the same before/after set also lives in the owner's Canva folder
OWNER-PROVIDED REFERENCE PHOTOS (2026-07-18), Claude rubric determination -
confirm the true charged level with Ben before using as ground truth:
2 maple, thinning/worn patches          -> L2 borderline L3 (wet-test)
3 pale sink base by window              -> human review (whitewash vs sun-fade)
4 heavy water stain, finish mostly gone -> L4 (verging L5)
5 oak, glossy, minimal wear             -> Maintenance / L1
